design.purpose: Hold compost and herbs on patio for household

steps.c: Lay wide board flat on ground
Mark 45 cm sides and 14 cm ends
Saw board into sides and ends
Lay middle board flat on ground
Lay narrow board flat on ground

Stand long sides on base edges
Drive screws through sides into base
Drive screws through front into ends
Drive screws through back into ends
Drill 5 drainage holes 8 mm in base
